blocks.AppFrame: top bar (four groups, search, acting-as), trail, main column, rail (Connected to; Capture here)
blocks.AttentionStrip: three tiles: do now (red) · this week (amber) · done (green); number, icon+word, one sentence; each a link
blocks.PeriodRow: time · subject edge+tag · name · state chip; the row is the link
blocks.StatusChip: icon + word + colour from the STATES rows; pill for work, square for a child's mark
blocks.DataTable: ≤10 rows then grouped/paged; needs-you first; numbers right, status centred; cards on a phone
blocks.FilterBar: dropdowns + compact search over any table of 6+ rows; filters in the address
blocks.ClassGrid: squares by Sr. No. on one skill; secure/practising/emerging/not seen; tap = act
blocks.Stepper: the steps of a thing; done green, waiting amber, late red, rest quiet
blocks.Details: a fold that opens on click, eye icon; never hides the main action
blocks.Timeline: what was seen, newest last; words beside the mark; a details fold each
blocks.ChildGraph: the child at the centre, skills as nodes coloured by state, sized by how often seen; each a link
blocks.StackBar: one bar split by state with a key of counts
blocks.LevelBars: four bars, levels 0–3, how many children at each
blocks.Spark: one line over six fortnights with the last value labelled
blocks.Trend: a child's level per sitting over dates
blocks.HeatGrid: classes × days: done / moved / not done / holiday, icon + word in each cell
blocks.FortnightGrid: week A and B × periods, cells coloured by subject; moved = amber outline, clash = red outline
blocks.CaptureBar: Voice note · Photo; the whole screen on a phone
blocks.DropZone: choose scans or drop them; or a Drive link
blocks.PageImage: the child's page as photographed, QR corner, never a name
blocks.EmptyState: nothing to show, with the next step
blocks.Form: a short form of labelled fields; one main button
blocks.KeyValue: facts as label: value pairs, five lines at most
blocks.Cards: two to three bordered blocks side by side, each with a title, a few lines and one link

screens.eyebrow: Tuesday 18-Nov · K2 Red · Fortnight 9, week A
screens.title: Today
screens.purpose: Your periods in order. Tap one for what to teach, how, and what to lay out. After it, record a note.

the count in the strip equals the rows behind it

screens.title: Today, the school
screens.purpose: What waits on you, each with its own button. Then the week ahead.

screens.title: Confirm what the reader heard
